topic: What if the Great Red Spot appeared above Earth?
fact: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant storm larger than Earth.
beats: A rust-red oval rises above the clouds.
It is Jupiter's Great Red Spot.
NASA says this storm is larger than Earth.
Its winds circle a world made mostly of gas.
It has raged for hundreds of years.
The storm dwarfs every hurricane we know.
How would you watch the sky tonight?
